methodology.measure: One repository per evidenced language or engineering domain. Counts describe source presence, never proficiency or authorship.
methodology.languages: Complete source trees plus inspected notebook code cells. PHP and JSP included. Java requires .java or Processing implementation; a Maven WAR or pure-HTML JSP does not establish Java source. HTML/CSS styling and dependencies/builds are excluded.
methodology.libraries: External libraries/frameworks imported and used in inspected implementation or notebook code cells. Dependency manifests, unused imports, prose and standard-library modules do not qualify. Each repository contributes once per library; this is source coverage, not execution verification.
methodology.aiml: Executable implementations of learning domains; dependencies and README claims do not qualify. Notebook markdown/outputs and unimplemented Python stubs are excluded.
methodology.agentic: Only Agentic Core family repositories and linkedin-agent-development-lab. Source implementation symbols, not other web apps or architecture prose.
methodology.privacy: Private evidence publishes only opaque per-repository IDs and skill names. No private names, filenames, snippets, blob hashes, URLs or notebook contents are published.
methodology.refresh: Evidence is captured on demand. A public-only capture preserves the sanitized private baseline and its separate capture date; a full authenticated audit can update both partitions.
methodology.cloud: Concrete provider integration or checked deployment/build manifests. Docker and Compose are container tooling; provider configurations are not proof of live production deployment. Cloud proofs retain their separately audited exact tree/blob revisions for public sources; private sources retain only opaque IDs and labels.

library_audit.scope: All 24 accessible original repositories are represented. External library evidence uses a bounded inspection of current implementation and notebook code; absent detections are not proof of absence.
library_audit.measure: One repository per verified imported and used external library. Standard-library modules and dependency manifests excluded.

cloud_audit.measure: One repository per evidenced cloud deployment platform or container tooling configuration. Percentages represent the share of repository-skill signals, not proficiency or usage time.
cloud_audit.qualification: Actual deployment/build manifests inspected at exact file SHAs. Docker includes container packaging used for a cloud-targeted application; Docker Compose includes multi-service deployment configuration. CI-only workflows, README claims, dependencies, provider logos and project names do not qualify.
cloud_audit.deployment_status: Configuration presence is not proof of successful provisioning, publication, production operation or current live deployment.
cloud_audit.excluded: Uninspected binary documents, README claims, dependencies and CI-only workflows do not establish cloud evidence.
